verdict.rationale: Edit-run iteration speed is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents hot reload, script recompilation speed, or near-instant preview after a script change. Generic marketing lines such as "iterate quickly with your team" and "build and review 3D projects in real time" are not about the script edit-run loop and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
